gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-kedebideri: Kedebideri sets a tall, rounded sans body whose curves stay open and inviting on the page. Outrun Future handles the heading with a wide-spaced outline of constant width, while Kedebideri does its best work in the softer, taller lowercase below.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-khula: Khula reads modern and level, with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open. Khula's low-contrast strokes meet Outrun Future's flat, unmodulated line above, and that shared plainness is what holds them together.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-krub: Contemporary letters with a pronounced x-height and pen-lifted curves make Krub feel lightly unfinished beneath the authoritative, synthwave headline of Outrun Future. Both draw their curves without stress.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-kufam: Outrun Future spaces its letters wide, tracing each one in a single constant outline. Kufam answers in a similar track width, like neon tube, with open-curved bodies that dominate the line while its ascenders barely show, and that shared tube-like stroke is what ties them.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend: Outrun Future keeps a wide distance between letters, each drawn as a constant-width outline. Lexend, in turn, has outsized lowercase with open jaws on every curve, so the heading does the commanding while Lexend does the quiet explaining.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-lexend-deca: Clean, approachable letters carry the text here, with terminals that stop short of curling back in. Lexend Deca draws an unshaded line that never swells, which echoes the constant-width outline of Outrun Future above.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-liter: Wide, flat, and unmistakably synthwave up top. Liter follows with no stroke contrast at all and lowercase that stands tall, so the heading's constant outline finds a modern, professional partner underneath.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-mada: Outrun Future looks drawn with one pen tip, wide and flat. Mada sits beneath with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close, so the heading's authority gets a friendlier plain sans to lean on.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-martel-sans: Wide, authoritative, and drawn at stem thickness even in the bowls, Outrun Future gives the pair its synthwave punch. Martel Sans adds generous openings.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-gf-matangi: Matangi has strokes like twine pressed flat, with hefty rounded lowercase. Outrun Future does its best work as a wide-spaced, constant-outline heading, while Matangi is happiest carrying the weight of the text below in open, rounded forms.
